google_review_notes: No login required. Tap Play to start level 1 (a short 3-step tutorial explains swiping and pushing). Daily puzzle is on the main menu; Levels opens all 500 levels by chapter (later levels unlock as you clear them). Endless mode is at the bottom of Levels and uses one heart per board. Shop holds coin packs, hints, Remove Ads and the optional Season/Weekly passes.
apple_review_notes: No login required. Tap Play to start level 1. To test in-app purchases, open Shop from the main menu; Restore Purchases is in Settings.
